results.title: NVIDIA Beats Q2 Earnings Expectations Driven by High Cloud & AI Demand
results.author: Sarah Jenkins
results.description: NVIDIA reported record quarterly revenue growth of 28% year-over-year. Management cited massive enterprise adoption of AI server infrastructure.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong top-line revenue beat and expanding profit margins in AI infrastructure.
